create_habitat_gym_env: create a Habitat 2.0 Gym environment using gym.make with a task name like HabitatPick-v0
run_habitat_env_step_loop: run a step loop in a Habitat Gym environment sampling random actions until done
render_habitat_env_video: render a Habitat Gym environment to an MP4 video using imageio and env.render
inspect_habitat_observation_space: inspect the observation space of a Habitat Gym environment using env.observation_space
configure_habitat_env_override: configure a Habitat Gym environment with override_options to change the gripper controller
